StringData.data:
A recovery item developed by Noah Pharmaceuticals.Injects Medical Nanobots into the body to provide immediate support to the user in emergency situations. Depletes after a single use.\nCannot be used in the Arena.
{color:#edec72}Trigger: HP falls below 20% Effect: Instantly recovers 50% HP Cooldown: 120 sec Application: Can be enabled in the Master window or the lobby support kit tab{color:end}

A recovery kit developed by Noah Pharmaceuticals. Injects Medical Nanobots into the body to repair damage over time. Expires after one use and cannot be used in the Arena.
{color:#edec72}Trigger: HP falls below 20% Effect: 5% of HP is recovered every second for 15 seconds. Cooldown: 120 sec Application: Can be enabled in the Master window or the lobby support kit tab{color:end}

A defense kit developed by the Genoss Guild after stealing Synd proprietary tech. The use is protected when abnormal brainwaves created by stress are detected, triggering a hardening of the flesh. \nSingle use. Cannot be used in the Arena.
{color:#edec72}Trigger: HP falls below 20% Effect: Defense increases by 100% for 20 seconds Cooldown: 120 sec Application: Can be enabled in the Master window or the lobby support kit tab{color:end}

A product developed for the front lines by Altair Industries for the Reclamation Fleet. It creases a powerful shockwave, inflicting damage on any nearby enemies and disorienting them. Can only be used once and cannot be used in the Arena.
{color:#edec72}Trigger: HP falls below 20% Effect: Stun targets within 5m radius for 2 seconds Cooldown: 120 sec Application: Can be enabled in the Master window or the lobby support kit tab{color:end}

A supply kit manufactured on the Dredgion and made specifically for Masters in the field. Injects Medical Nanobots into the body to provide immediate support to the user in emergency situations. Depletes after a single use.\nCannot be used in an Arena.
{color:#edec72}Trigger: HP falls below 20% Effect: Instantly recovers 10% HP Cooldown: 120 sec Application: Can be enabled in the Master window or the lobby support kit tab{color:end}

A supply kit based off similar Genoss kits. Manufactured on the Dredgion and made specifically for Masters in the field. The kit monitors brainwaves for stressful situations and triggers off of those signals, coating the flesh in hard scales. \nSingle use. Cannot be used in an Arena.
{color:#edec72}Trigger: HP falls below 20% Effect: Defense increases by 100% for 5 seconds Cooldown: 120 sec Application: Can be enabled in the Master window or the lobby support kit tab{color:end}
